_comment: v0.20 Onslaught draft of the Field manual's words (spec section 13, brief B3), for the owner's review on the v0.20 review page and the B3 Figma frame. Only the pages that change. Same rules as manual-text.json: {Path} is a number from GameConfig.xml or a derived figure, [[Name]] links a page, **x** highlights, no typed balance numbers. New paths ({Burn/...}, {Bomber/LeapReach}, {Sniper/AimSeconds}, {Combat/MinHit}, BlastResist, FlatArmour, BuildSeconds on a building) and the derived figures marked NEW exist once v0.20's config lands. Once approved, these replace the matching entries in manual-text.json (SuicideBomber becomes Bomber, Bomb becomes Mine) and the hover cards' role lines follow (HoverText.UnitRole). Strong / Weak claims are left out until the balance pass: manual-mock.js checks them against balance-sheet.js, which learns the v0.20 rules first (spec section 10).

Bomber.role: Leaps into an army and explodes. Hurts friends too.
body: On an attack-move, or idle with an enemy in sight, it runs at the middle of the nearest army. Once an enemy unit is within {Unit/Bomber/Range} tiles it **leaps** over the units in its way, lands in that army's centre, at most {Bomber/LeapReach} tiles away, and explodes: everything within {Unit/Bomber/BlastRadius} tiles is hit, **your own and your allies' included**.

**In the air it can't be hit**, and nothing stops the leap. Walls, rock and buildings stop it leaping at all: it only leaps when the line to its landing point is clear, and otherwise keeps running. Against a building it leaps onto the middle of a side.

On the ground **it explodes whenever it dies**, and at {Derived/LastGaspPercent} % health or less. It shrugs off {Derived/BomberBlastResistPercent} % of any blast, so bombers don't set each other off: shoot them down on the way in, a [[Gun turret]] best of all, far from what you are protecting. Detonate ({Key/Detonate}) sets off every selected bomber that is on the ground.

Sniper.role: Stops and aims, then one huge shot. Best against Heavies.
body: A large unit that fires from {Unit/Sniper/Range} tiles but sees only {Unit/Sniper/Sight}, so it needs a [[Scout]], a [[Radar]] or an ally to spot for it. Each shot does {Unit/Sniper/Damage}, and {Derived/SniperHeavyMultiplier} times that to [[Heavy|Heavies]]: two shots kill one.

**It stops to aim.** For {Sniper/AimSeconds} s before each shot it stands still with its target in sight, and a red laser shows your side what it aims at. Moving, losing the target or changing target starts the aim again. On a Move order it doesn't aim.
It does little to light units, buildings and walls, and it can't fire at anything closer than {Unit/Sniper/MinRange} tiles. Keep something in front of it.

Flamethrower.role: Sets groups on fire at range.
body: Its flame reaches {Unit/Flamethrower/Range} tiles and splashes every enemy within {Unit/Flamethrower/Splash} tiles of the target. Each hit does little on its own, but **everything it hits catches fire** and burns for {Burn/Seconds} s, losing {Burn/Dps} health a second.
A fire doesn't stack: a new hit only restarts it. [[Heavy|Heavies]] burn at half rate, walls don't burn, and fire doesn't spread from one unit to the next. Allies are never hit or set on fire.
It wears whole groups down for the rest of your army to finish. On its own it kills one unit slowly.

Artillery.role: Shells far past its sight, over walls.
body: Fires from {Unit/Artillery/Range} tiles, twice as far as it sees, so it only fires at what a [[Scout]], a [[Radar]] or an ally shows your side. It can't fire at anything closer than {Unit/Artillery/MinRange}.

Its shell flies over walls, not rock, and lands where the target will be if it keeps driving straight: a unit that turns or stops can get away. The blast hits everything within {Unit/Artillery/BlastRadius} tiles for up to {Unit/Artillery/BlastDamage}, double to buildings, and **your own and your allies' units take {Derived/ArtilleryFriendlyPercent} % of it**.
It reloads for {Unit/Artillery/AttackInterval} s after each shot. Keep it behind the line, and keep something between it and anything fast.

Scout.role: Fast, and sees furthest: the spotter.
body: The fastest unit and the one that sees furthest, {Unit/Scout/Sight} tiles. Ahead of your gun line it lets [[Artillery]] and [[Sniper]]s fire to their full range, and it can look round a wall for them.
Its weak gun only does real damage to light units, and it bounces off [[Heavy|Heavies]]' armour. Use it to look and to hunt [[Builder]]s, not to fight.

Takes the fire so that the rest of your army doesn't. **Armour** takes {Unit/Heavy/FlatArmour} off every shot, so small arms like a [[Scout]]'s do {Combat/MinHit} a hit, and it shrugs off {Derived/HeavyBlastResistPercent} % of any blast. Fire burns it at half rate.
Its big gun hits buildings hard. It is slow and large, it passes a narrow chokepoint in single file, and a [[Sniper]] is built to kill it.

GunTurret.role: Fires ten shots a second. Shoots Bombers first.
body: A large, costly turret that takes {Building/GunTurret/BuildSeconds} s for one Builder to build. It fires very fast: at a [[Bomber]] in range first, then the nearest enemy unit it has a clear line to, then buildings, then walls.

It shreds light units and bombers on the way in, but its small rounds barely scratch [[Heavy|Heavies]]' armour, and [[Artillery]] and [[Sniper]]s out-range it. It doesn't fire as a blueprint or while its upkeep is unpaid.

Only you and those you share vision with can see it, and Radars can't. A unit of any player you attack sets it off: a blast of {Siege/BlastDamage} within {Siege/BlastRadius} tiles that hits everything, **your own units included**.
Everyone who can see the tile sees the explosion, and you get an alert. Place them where armies must pass: chokepoints and the entrances to your base. [[Bomber]]s shrug its blast off.

newSections.heading: Armour
paras: Some units carry armour. It comes off every shot after the [[Damage table]], and a shot never does less than {Combat/MinHit}. It does nothing against blasts or fire.

newSections.heading: Blasts
paras: A blast is a [[Bomber]] exploding, an [[Artillery]] shell landing or a [[Mine]] going off. It does full damage at its centre and half at its edge, and hits your own side too (the Artillery's a share of it). Each unit shrugs off its own share of any blast: [[Bomber]]s nearly all of it, [[Heavy|Heavies]] half, [[Artillery]] a quarter, the rest none. Its page says how much.

newSections.heading: Fire
paras: A [[Flamethrower]]'s hit sets a unit or building burning for {Burn/Seconds} s. Light units and buildings lose {Burn/Dps} health a second, heavy units half that, and walls never burn. A new hit restarts the fire, nothing else puts it out, and it never spreads. Fire ignores armour, and its kills go to whoever lit it.

newSections.heading: Spotting
paras: A unit fires only at what your side sees now. [[Artillery]] and [[Sniper]]s fire further than they see, so put a [[Scout]] ahead of them: whatever it sees, they can hit. Walls block everyone's sight, but an Artillery shell flies over them, so a Scout looking round a wall lets it shell what is behind.
